description: Source code for a Zephyr display driver for LS0xx series e-paper displays, including initialization, display update, and GPIO control functions.

methods.name: ls0xx_blanking_off
methods.description: Turns off display blanking, enabling the display.

methods.name: ls0xx_blanking_on
methods.description: Turns on display blanking, disabling the display.

methods.name: ls0xx_cmd
methods.description: Sends a command buffer over SPI to the display.

methods.name: ls0xx_update_display
methods.description: Updates specific lines on the display with provided data.

methods.name: ls0xx_write
methods.description: Writes pixel data to the display at specified coordinates.

methods.name: ls0xx_get_capabilities
methods.description: Retrieves display capabilities such as resolution and pixel format.

methods.name: ls0xx_set_pixel_format
methods.description: Sets pixel format, only monochrome supported.

methods.name: ls0xx_init
methods.description: Initializes the display device, configures GPIOs, and clears display.
